in_marathi.name: Jaspal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaspal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaspal is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Jas', meaning 'gold' and 'Paal', meaning 'treasure'. In Hindu mythology, Jaspal represents the divine treasure of knowledge and wisdom. The name is often associated with the god of wealth, Kubera, and is believed to bring prosperity and abundance.
